source: User screenshots and clarification to compare both the leveler and maxed supports
rules: The leveler compares all unlocked existing styles plus Magnate at rank 4000. Tycoon remains available from rank 1250.
Support styles compare inherited or explicit Grand Master, Tycoon and Magnate. An explicit Tycoon/Magnate works when the account GM toggle is off; Grand Master follows that toggle.
Duplicate copies share their hero's combat style. Every changed copy leaves the GM count. If entered duplicate levels differ, the lowest copy level gates the shared style.
Only actual Grand Masters contribute to GM milestone strength. Synergy strength includes GM, Tycoon and Magnate under the configured additive or multiplicative stacking rule.
Global Rank EXP percentage factors apply once per deployed copy. They remain distinct from additive Rank EXP and from XP active-skill reward factors.
Tycoon adds 5 flat Energy Income. Magnate multiplies the base-plus-flat Energy Income pool by 1.05, before amount and spillover factors.
Instant Spell is recorded but not scored as a payout multiplier or chance spillover. Skill uptime and kill rate are not simulated; captured ability profiles stay fixed as combat styles change.
Current lineups retain their assigned or inherited styles. The per-team optimization option enables style changes during XP team, tile and leveling-plan searches. Disabling it retains manual choices.
Locks protect hero identity and level; styles may move like tiles when support-style optimization is enabled.
For fixed rosters and tiles, XP support effects depend on style counts. The exact count search groups duplicate hero IDs. Overall roster/style/tile search remains heuristic.
Recorded references freeze their actual style assignments. The all-GM capture option overrides mixed support assignments without changing the current lineup.
Support combat styles apply only to Experience lineups; other focus requirements remain unchanged.
